name: cells
expr: [(c.Value, c.String, doc.NumberFormats.getByKey(c.NumberFormat).Type) for c in [doc.TextTables.getByIndex(0).getCellByPosition(i,0) for i in range(3)]]

name: fields
expr: [(f.Value, doc.NumberFormats.getByKey(f.NumberFormat).Type) for f in [e.nextElement() for e in [doc.TextFields.createEnumeration()] for _ in range(1)]]
